entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I'm calling about my VeloBand Pulse. I... I need to return it.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and the order number, please?
Yes, it's Sarah Miller. Order number is VF98765.
Thank you, Sarah. I have your account pulled up. To make sure I understand the situation correctly, is there a technical fault with the band, or is it more of a preference issue?
Oh, no, it's not broken. It's just... I haven't even really used it. I had a medical emergency right after it arrived. It was completely unexpected.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope everything is okay.

It's been difficult. I was in the hospital for over a week, and now I'm facing a long recovery from a necessary surgery. With all that and my son's sudden military deployment, things are just... overwhelming. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I really needed this money back for bills.
That sounds incredibly stressful, Sarah. I completely understand. Let me just check the policy details for you here... One moment.

Okay, I see here that your VeloBand Pulse was delivered on December 15th, which was 21 days ago. According to our policy, all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. So, you are well within the window.
Oh, really? I was so worried I had missed the deadline with everything that happened at the hospital. That's such a relief. Thank you.

It's absolutely no problem. I'm happy I can make things a little easier for you. I'm processing the return now. I've just sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on your account. Just pack the band in its original box, apply the label, and drop it at a post office when you can.
That's perfect. You have no idea what a help this is, especially with the upcoming surgery.
You're very welcome. Once our warehouse receives the item, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again, Alex.
My pleasure, Sarah. I wish you a speedy recovery. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
